content.short: Cyberscope is a leading blockchain security firm offering smart contract audits, KYC, and AML analytics.
content.description: Cyberscope is a blockchain security firm focused on smart contract audits, KYC services, and AML analytics. With more than two years in the space, Cyberscope has established itself as a trusted partner with major launchpads and notable entities such as CoinMarketCap, CoinGecko, Polygon Village, and Techstars. Cyberscope supports a broad range of networks, including Solana, Avalanche, Bitcoin, Arbitrum, BNB Chain, Ethereum, Polygon, Polygon zkEVM, Polkadot, Fantom, OP Mainnet, and Cosmos.
